The '''Infernal Council''' was the name of a group of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Purebloods]] who had been [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of [[Soa]] during his reign thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was formed. They were imprisoned in stasis with him in the [[Eternity Vault]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].

When a strike team [[Invasion of Belsavis|infiltrated]] the Eternity Vault they released these warriors and faced them in one-on-one duels. All members of the council were [[Death/Legends|killed]].

*[[Jekhop]], the Bowed Lord<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Fahren Jaj]], the Laughing Lord<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Keryha]], Sister of Sorrow<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Serrod]] the Messenger<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Kahesh]] the Reborn<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Wei'val the Elder]]<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[R'hoteb]], the Bowed Lord<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Yshaar Kael]], the Betrayer of [[Adas]]<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Wei'val the Lesser]]<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Kyyrah]], the Jewel of [[Xo]]<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Za'heen Kaur]], the Bowed Lord<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
*[[Luthro]] the Kinslayer<ref name="Eternity Vault" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Infernal Council serves as the penultimate boss of ''Operation: The Eternity Vault'' in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Each member of the council must be fought individually by a member of the raiding party.
